metadata.description: Red tiles form a ceramic ram silhouette with a large curled horn inspired by Opishne toys. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Open constellation surround the motif, with slalom gates along the lower route. 3 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 6 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
